packs.name: Wallpaper Engine
packs.description: Stops the animated wallpaper while a tracked app runs and restores it afterwards (64-bit CLI by default, the 32-bit sibling as the dropdown option).

packs.name: G-Helper
packs.description: Switches G-Helper's performance mode (Turbo / Balanced / Silent) while a tracked app runs and restores the captured mode afterwards. Works through G-Helper's own hotkeys.

packs.name: Rainmeter
packs.description: Swaps Rainmeter to an empty layout while a tracked app runs and reloads the @Backup snapshot afterwards. The empty layout is picked automatically.
